chunks: Whoever walks toward a person of innovation and shows him respect has indeed striven in the destruction of Islam.

key_terms.الْإِسْلَامِ: Islam, the religion being harmed by such conduct
key_terms.صَاحِبِ: one associated with or characterized by
key_terms.فَوَقَّرَهُ: then honored him or showed him reverence

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about honoring a person of religious innovation?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام warns against honoring and dignifying a person of bidʿah (religious innovation). The hadith teaches that showing reverence to false religious innovation strengthens it socially and harms Islam.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Whoever walks towards a person of innovation and shows him respect has indeed contributed to the destruction of Islam."
